strings.en: Its body is very thin, and it stays{NEWLINE}stuck to walls. Its shape seems to{NEWLINE}have some kind of meaning.

strings.zh: 它体内的细胞是由超级进化产生的{NEWLINE}能量结晶而成，比任何矿物都坚固，{NEWLINE}能够承受任何温度。
strings.en: Its cells are crystals of Mega{NEWLINE}Evolution energy. Tougher than any{NEWLINE}mineral, they endure any temperature.

strings.zh: 比起夹击，它更擅长用钳子抡打对手。{NEWLINE}长时间战斗后，{NEWLINE}它就会变得无法承受钳子的重量。
strings.en: It clubs foes with its pincers more{NEWLINE}than it pinches. After long battles,{NEWLINE}it can no longer bear their weight.

strings.zh: 超级进化结束后，{NEWLINE}它就会受苦于强烈的肌肉疼痛。
strings.en: When Mega Evolution ends, it suffers{NEWLINE}from terrible muscle pain.

strings.zh: 它是因急遽环境变化{NEWLINE}而死去的远古太阳珊瑚。{NEWLINE}会用珊瑚枝吸取人的精气。
strings.en: An ancient Corsola that died from{NEWLINE}sudden environmental change. It drains{NEWLINE}people’s spirit with its branches.

strings.zh: 全身会因超级进化而发热。{NEWLINE}能喷出烈焰吐息，{NEWLINE}将对手烧成焦炭。
strings.en: Mega Evolution makes its whole body{NEWLINE}burn hot. It breathes blazing flames{NEWLINE}that burn foes to a crisp.

strings.zh: 因超级进化的影响，{NEWLINE}它变得更加粗暴了。{NEWLINE}不清楚它是否还会听从训练家的命令。
strings.en: Mega Evolution made it even more{NEWLINE}violent. It is unclear whether it will{NEWLINE}still obey its Trainer’s orders.

strings.zh: 会运用高速的脚力快速接近对手。{NEWLINE}切断巨大的尾巴，{NEWLINE}可以像导弹一般发射攻击对手。
strings.en: It closes in on foes with speedy{NEWLINE}footwork. It can cut off its huge tail{NEWLINE}and fire it at foes like a missile.

strings.zh: 引以为傲的飞脚变得更强。{NEWLINE}当它重复使出飞脚时，{NEWLINE}脚会因为和空气的磨擦燃烧。
strings.en: Its prized flying kicks grow even{NEWLINE}stronger. When it kicks over and over,{NEWLINE}air friction sets its legs on fire.

strings.zh: 当它超级进化时，{NEWLINE}在水中行动的力量会增加。{NEWLINE}能在陆地和水中发挥其顽强的力量。
strings.en: Mega Evolution increases its strength{NEWLINE}for moving in water. It shows great{NEWLINE}power both on land and in water.

strings.zh: 这似乎是蛇纹熊最古老的样子。{NEWLINE}会之字形乱走，{NEWLINE}把周围弄得一团糟。
strings.en: This seems to be the oldest form of{NEWLINE}Zigzagoon. It wanders in zigzags,{NEWLINE}making a mess of its surroundings.

strings.zh: 有着十分好战的性情。{NEWLINE}即使是比自己强的对手{NEWLINE}也会鲁莽地发起挑战。
strings.en: It is very warlike. It recklessly{NEWLINE}challenges even foes stronger than{NEWLINE}itself.

strings.zh: 解放了自己的心之后，{NEWLINE}就可以释放出强大的超能力。据说其{NEWLINE}胸口的红色结构是它实体化的内心。
strings.en: Freeing its heart lets it unleash great{NEWLINE}psychic power. The red part on its{NEWLINE}chest is said to be its heart made real.

strings.zh: 巨大化的宝石可以防御住所有攻击。{NEWLINE}但是因为特别重，{NEWLINE}不擅长移动。
strings.en: Its enlarged gem can block any{NEWLINE}attack, but the gem is so heavy that{NEWLINE}it is bad at moving around.

strings.zh: 2个颚部像是有意识一样，{NEWLINE}猛烈地大闹着。{NEWLINE}只要咬一口，连岩石都能粉碎。
strings.en: Its two jaws rampage as if they have{NEWLINE}minds of their own. A single bite can{NEWLINE}crush even rock.

strings.zh: 超级进化后的波士可多拉{NEWLINE}头上的角的可怕的破坏力足以将{NEWLINE}一辆全副武装的坦克变成一坨废铁。
strings.en: The horn on Mega Aggron’s head is so{NEWLINE}destructive that it can turn a fully{NEWLINE}armed tank into a heap of scrap.

strings.zh: 能用增强的精神力量为自己创造{NEWLINE}额外的手臂。 它的精神训练得越多，{NEWLINE}这些手臂就会变得愈发真实和灵巧。
strings.en: It makes extra arms with its boosted{NEWLINE}psychic power. The more it trains its{NEWLINE}mind, the more real and deft they get.

strings.zh: 因身体里储存着过多的电而焦躁不安。{NEWLINE}有着与落雷相同速度的瞬间爆发力。
strings.en: Excess stored electricity makes it{NEWLINE}restless. It bursts into action as{NEWLINE}fast as a lightning strike.

strings.zh: 在猛撞的瞬间，{NEWLINE}会从头上射出尖刺，{NEWLINE}给对手的身体造成很深的伤。
strings.en: The instant it rams a foe, it shoots{NEWLINE}spikes from its head, leaving deep{NEWLINE}wounds in the foe’s body.

strings.zh: 它背上的驼峰已经变成了一座{NEWLINE}巨大且非常活跃的火山。 十分厌恶{NEWLINE}水分和潮湿，性格十分火爆。
strings.en: The hump on its back is now a huge,{NEWLINE}very active volcano. It hates water{NEWLINE}and damp and has a fiery temper.

strings.zh: 它的歌声比超级进化前更加动听。{NEWLINE}用于保护自身的羽毛变得更大，{NEWLINE}并闪烁着彩虹般的光泽。
strings.en: Its song is lovelier than before Mega{NEWLINE}Evolution. Its protective feathers{NEWLINE}grow bigger and shimmer like a rainbow.

strings.zh: 如果在烈日下暴晒，{NEWLINE}就会变成这个样子。如果碰到它{NEWLINE}热烘烘的身体，会感觉干巴巴的。
strings.en: It takes this form when bathed in{NEWLINE}blazing sun. Touch its hot body, and{NEWLINE}it feels bone-dry.

strings.zh: 被雨淋到时飘浮泡泡的样子。{NEWLINE}在让它淋浴的实验里，{NEWLINE}没有变成这个形态。
strings.en: Castform’s form when rained on. In an{NEWLINE}experiment where it was given a{NEWLINE}shower, it did not take this form.

strings.zh: 如果被冰雹打到，{NEWLINE}就会变成这个样子。{NEWLINE}全身冷冷的，皮肤有点儿冻住。
strings.en: It takes this form when pelted by{NEWLINE}hail. Its whole body is chilly, and its{NEWLINE}skin is a little frozen.

strings.zh: 因为超级进化，{NEWLINE}怨念增强。{NEWLINE}拉链里面收纳着的诅咒之力满溢出来。
strings.en: Mega Evolution strengthens its{NEWLINE}grudges. The cursed power stored{NEWLINE}inside its zipper overflows.

strings.zh: 超级进化的能量变作威慑的气场，{NEWLINE}四散播撒。{NEWLINE}胆怯的人会被惊吓致死。
strings.en: Mega Evolution energy becomes an{NEWLINE}intimidating aura that it spreads all{NEWLINE}around. The timid can die of fright.

strings.zh: 超级进化的力量过强，{NEWLINE}颚部都碎掉了。{NEWLINE}因没法好好吃东西而焦躁。
strings.en: Mega Evolution’s power was so strong{NEWLINE}it shattered its jaws. Unable to eat{NEWLINE}properly, it is always irritable.

strings.zh: 会将前脚收拢在外壳的间隙中，{NEWLINE}变为飞行的姿势。即使是复杂的地形{NEWLINE}也能以高速飞来飞去。
strings.en: It tucks its forelegs into its shell to{NEWLINE}take a flying pose. It zips about at{NEWLINE}high speed, even over rough land.

strings.zh: 如果判断自己无法战胜，{NEWLINE}就会用爪子抓住对手，{NEWLINE}开始大爆炸的倒计时。
strings.en: If it judges it can’t win, it grabs its{NEWLINE}foe with its claws and starts the{NEWLINE}countdown to a huge explosion.

strings.zh: 超级进化后更加善于旋转，{NEWLINE}能迅速紧急进行地回旋转弯，{NEWLINE}在宝可梦里拥有最高级别的速度。
strings.en: Mega Evolution makes it better at{NEWLINE}spinning, so it can turn sharply at{NEWLINE}once. It is among the fastest Pokémon.

strings.zh: 超级进化后更加善于飞行，{NEWLINE}它能以 4马赫的速度在天空飞，{NEWLINE}在宝可梦里拥有最高级别的速度。
strings.en: Mega Evolution makes it better at{NEWLINE}flying. It can fly at Mach 4, making it{NEWLINE}one of the fastest Pokémon.

strings.zh: 通过自然的能量进行原始回归，{NEWLINE}恢复原本的样子。{NEWLINE}其力量可以呼风唤雨扩张海洋。
strings.en: Nature’s energy caused its Primal{NEWLINE}Reversion to its true form. Its power{NEWLINE}can raise storms and expand the seas.

strings.zh: 通过自然的能量进行原始回归，{NEWLINE}恢复原本的样子。{NEWLINE}其力量可以产生熔岩扩张大地。
strings.en: Nature’s energy caused its Primal{NEWLINE}Reversion to its true form. Its power{NEWLINE}makes magma and expands the land.

strings.zh: 从突出下颚伸出的长触须放出粒子。{NEWLINE}这些粒子能控制气体的浓度{NEWLINE}和湿度，操纵天气。
strings.en: Long feelers on its jutting jaw release{NEWLINE}particles that control gas density and{NEWLINE}humidity, and thus the weather.

strings.zh: 变化为攻击形态的代欧奇希斯{NEWLINE}能够变换形态来迷惑对手。
strings.en: In its Attack Forme, Deoxys can{NEWLINE}change its shape to confuse foes.

strings.zh: 变化形态的时候会出现极光。{NEWLINE}通过变化细胞形态来吸取攻击。
strings.en: Auroras appear when it changes form.{NEWLINE}It absorbs attacks by changing the{NEWLINE}shape of its cells.

strings.zh: 当宇宙病毒被激光照射时，{NEWLINE}发生突变而形成的宝可梦。{NEWLINE}身体的形状很适合快速移动。
strings.en: A Pokémon born when a space virus{NEWLINE}mutated after a laser hit it. Its body{NEWLINE}is shaped for moving at high speed.

strings.zh: 将吐出的丝揉合泥沙制成蓑衣。{NEWLINE}泥沙所制的蓑衣不耐风雨，{NEWLINE}因此它会躲藏在洞穴等处。
strings.en: It makes a cloak by mixing its thread{NEWLINE}with sand. The sand cloak can’t stand{NEWLINE}wind or rain, so it hides in caves.

strings.zh: 当身边找不到适合的材料时，{NEWLINE}会用尘土草芥等垃圾来做蓑衣。{NEWLINE}裹起来的感觉似乎意外地还不坏。
strings.en: If it can’t find good materials, it{NEWLINE}makes its cloak from dust and litter.{NEWLINE}The feel of it seems surprisingly nice.

strings.zh: 泥沙形成的皮肤有相当的硬度。{NEWLINE}若是姆克儿的嘴喙程度的攻击，{NEWLINE}轻而易举就可以反弹回去。
strings.en: Its skin, formed from sand, is fairly{NEWLINE}hard. Attacks as weak as a Starly’s{NEWLINE}peck bounce right off it.

strings.zh: 尘土草芥等垃圾构成的身体{NEWLINE}能毫不起眼地融入周围景色之中，{NEWLINE}正好适合用来躲避天敌袭击。
strings.en: Its body of dust and litter blends{NEWLINE}into its surroundings, perfect for{NEWLINE}hiding from natural enemies.

strings.zh: 一到了晴天就会非常积极地活动起来，{NEWLINE}但只要太阳被遮住，{NEWLINE}就会立刻闭上花瓣停止动作。
strings.en: On sunny days it is very active, but{NEWLINE}as soon as the sun is hidden, it{NEWLINE}closes its petals and stops moving.

strings.zh: 经常能在岩岸发现它的身影。{NEWLINE}如果只是一定程度的时间，{NEWLINE}它也能在陆地上活动。
strings.en: It is often seen on rocky shores. It{NEWLINE}can also move about on land, as long{NEWLINE}as it isn’t for too long.

strings.zh: 渔夫说道，{NEWLINE}虽然曾经很少遇见这个样子的海兔兽，{NEWLINE}但现在它们有增加的倾向。
strings.en: Fishermen say Gastrodon with this{NEWLINE}look were once a rare sight, but{NEWLINE}their numbers are on the rise.

strings.zh: 战斗的本能因超级进化而觉醒。{NEWLINE}会舍弃干扰它攻击的毛发。
strings.en: Mega Evolution awakened its fighting{NEWLINE}instincts. It has shed the fur that{NEWLINE}got in the way of its attacks.

strings.zh: 性格比超级进化前更粗暴。{NEWLINE}会用双臂的镰刀把敌人割得粉碎。
strings.en: It is even more violent than before{NEWLINE}Mega Evolution. It slices foes to{NEWLINE}pieces with the scythes on its arms.

strings.zh: 沐浴在爆发性的能量中，{NEWLINE}使得斗争的本能觉醒了。{NEWLINE}对于敌人，毫不留情。
strings.en: Bathed in explosive energy, its{NEWLINE}fighting instincts have awakened. It{NEWLINE}shows its foes no mercy.

strings.zh: 背后的四颗新芽会长成巨大的冰柱，{NEWLINE}不喜欢与他人交往，{NEWLINE}选择在深山里安静地生活。
strings.en: The four new buds on its back grow{NEWLINE}into huge icicles. Unsociable, it lives{NEWLINE}quietly deep in the mountains.

strings.zh: 超级艾路雷朵具有骑士般的外表。{NEWLINE}能用精神力量将双臂化为刀刃，{NEWLINE}并运用双刀战斗。
strings.en: Mega Gallade looks like a knight. It{NEWLINE}turns its arms into blades with{NEWLINE}psychic power and fights with both.

strings.zh: 钻进了烤箱微波炉的样子。{NEWLINE}会用高温将周围烤得焦黑，{NEWLINE}然后开心地大笑。
strings.en: Rotom inside a microwave oven. It{NEWLINE}scorches its surroundings black with{NEWLINE}intense heat, then laughs with glee.

strings.zh: 由于已经停止生产，{NEWLINE}能让洛托姆钻进去的洗衣机{NEWLINE}在市场上被高价买卖。
strings.en: Washing machines that Rotom can{NEWLINE}enter are no longer made, so they{NEWLINE}sell for high prices.

strings.zh: 装在冰箱里的特殊马达是让{NEWLINE}洛托姆发生形态变化的关键。
strings.en: The special motor in the refrigerator{NEWLINE}is the key to Rotom’s change of form.

strings.zh: 虽然能让洛托姆钻进去的{NEWLINE}家电产品有好几种，{NEWLINE}但最先被研发出来的是电风扇。
strings.en: Rotom can enter several kinds of{NEWLINE}appliances, but the electric fan was{NEWLINE}the first to be developed.

strings.zh: 钻进割草机的样子。{NEWLINE}砍倒花草后，{NEWLINE}它会自信满满地耀武扬威。
strings.en: Rotom inside a lawn mower. After{NEWLINE}cutting down plants and flowers, it{NEWLINE}struts about full of confidence.

strings.zh: 脚部随着形态变化而消失。{NEWLINE}据推测，此宝可梦栖息于没有天地{NEWLINE}之分的世界，然而没有手段能证明。
strings.en: Its legs vanish when it changes form.{NEWLINE}It is thought to live in a world with{NEWLINE}no up or down, but there is no proof.

strings.zh: 当嗅闻珍奇之花的香味时，{NEWLINE}娇小的身体将在光辉中变成此形貌。
strings.en: When it smells the scent of a rare{NEWLINE}flower, its tiny body is wrapped in{NEWLINE}radiance and takes on this form.

strings.zh: 在神话里，{NEWLINE}它被描述为宇宙尚未存在时，{NEWLINE}就诞生的最早的宝可梦。
strings.en: Myths describe it as the first{NEWLINE}Pokémon, born before the universe{NEWLINE}even existed.
